prospects.fitSummary: Kîsik GeoSpatial lets a reviewer decide whether to clear current activity while adding its Canadian aerial-survey and hyperspectral operating context, using bst.gc.ca and the official product surface as the evidence route.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Resolved Kîsik's public operating identity, Delta address and contact route from its official organization surface.
Resolved the hyperspectral product boundary and VNIR-SWIR application surface without inferring current post-accident capacity.
Confirmed the 2025-07-26 occurrence and December 2025 active-investigation update; the page provides no final cause, fault or exact date for continuing status.
The French TSB page repeated the same occurrence and month-only investigation update and added no distinct publishable activity date.
Recovered independent historical British Columbia project evidence but no current post-accident fleet capacity, named active contract or defence deployment.
An exact-name CanadaBuys search yielded no durable Kîsik award or current procurement record suitable for this dossier.
